architecture_decision: ADR不要: The alternative of recomputing the whole reconciliation block on every binding pass was rejected because other reconciliation reasons (delivery, canonical audit persistence) are owned by their own code paths; the compatible boundary is that applyDecisionOutcomeBinding only removes the failure marker it itself sets. Rollback is reverting the single function change; artifacts written with the stale flag remain valid and self-heal on the next successful binding pass.
